titles.title: I am the only the one who levels up
Вебтун. Поднятие уровня в одиночку. Solo Leveling
俺だけレベルアップな件
俺だけレベルアップな件〜外伝〜

description:
In a world where awakened beings called “Hunters” must battle deadly monsters to protect humanity, Sung Jinwoo, nicknamed “the weakest hunter of all mankind,” finds himself in a constant struggle for survival. One day, after a brutal encounter in an overpowered dungeon wipes out his party and threatens to end his life, a mysterious System chooses him as its sole player: Jinwoo has been granted the rare opportunity to level up his abilities, possibly beyond any known limits. Follow Jinwoo’s journey as he takes on ever-stronger enemies, both human and monster, to discover the secrets deep within the dungeons and the ultimate extent of his powers.

*Source: Tappytoon*

---

Known as the Weakest Hunter of All Mankind, E-rank hunter Jinwoo Sung’s contribution to raids amounts to trying not to get killed. Unfortunately, between his mother’s hospital bills, his sister’s tuition, and his own lack of job prospects, he has no choice but to continue to put his life on the line. So when an opportunity arises for a bigger payout, he takes it…only to come face-to-face with a being whose power outranks anything he’s ever seen! With the party leader missing an arm and the only healer a quivering mess, can Jinwoo some­how find them a way out?

*Source: Yen Press, Vol. 1*

Ji-U is a kind-hearted young man who harnesses the lightning quick reflexes of a cat to secretly make the world a better place – one saved little child or foster pet at a time. Kayden is a secret agent on the run, who finds himself stuck in the body of a…um…decidedly fat old fluffy cat. Together, armed with Ji-U’s super powers and Kayden’s uber-smarts, they’re out to fight those forces who would let evil rule this world. That is, if they can stand each other long enough to get the job done. 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

titles.title: เลวีอาธาน อสูรใต้ทะเลลึก
レヴィアタン～深海に棲む獣～

description:
The world is submerged, and sea monsters rule the earth. Will Bota and his family ever make it to safety and escape this aquatic hell? And who in the world is Kana?!

(Source: Toomics)

*Notes:
\- Includes six extra chapters.
\- Originally published on Toomics where chapters 1-3 were subsequently combined to form chapters 1-2 on Naver.*

titles.title: จดหมายของยอน

description:
When middle schooler So-Ri Lee stood up for her friend against their entire class, she never expected to become their new target—but that’s exactly what happens. So, when her friend decides to transfer schools, So-Ri decides to wipe the slate clean and does the same. Luckily, someone seems to be looking out for her this time, and on her first day, she finds a mysterious letter taped to the bottom of her desk inviting her on a scavenger hunt! So-Ri follows the trail of clues to try and uncover the identity of her benefactor, and as she explores all the curious and wonderful people and places around the school, begins to open her heart once more... 

(Source: Yen Press, edited)

titles.title: สูตรลับฉบับเลิฟ

description:
Ba-Reum’s planner might be full, but one thing she desperately needs in her diary is a date. When she is lured into joining a programming club by her friend’s hot coworker, it looks like there might be hope for her. But will her inexperience lead to her downfall? And why does she keep running into his bad-tempered friend instead? 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

*Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

titles.title: I Got a Date With the President
นัดบอดวุ่น ลุ้นรักท่านประธาน
お見合い相手はうちのボス

description:
**A PROPOSAL OF A LIFETIME**

Hari Shin has officially hit rock bottom. After being worked to the bone at her office job, meeting her long time crush’s girlfriend, and helping to pay off her family’s debt, she’s 0 for 3 with work, love, and money. Luckily, her friend Yeongsuh has a business proposal for her: go on an arranged date in her stead, and Hari will receive a hefty compensation. Things grow complicated, however, when the other party turns out to be her new CEO-and he’s got a proposal of his own!

*Source: Yen Press, Vol. 1*

Hiitoteki Renaidan ~Ore wa Renai nanka Motometenai!~ Gaiden

非意図的恋愛談～俺は恋愛なんか求めてない！～外伝

description:
Won-Young gets unjustly suspended from work after getting caught up in a corruption scandal. But when he accidentally discovers the chairman's favorite artist Yoon Tae-Jun living under an alias, he is tasked with a tricky new mission. Could this be Won-Young's chance to get his job back? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: WEAK HERO นักเรียนดีเดือด

description:
Once the bullies target you, it’s game over. The school is run by tyrants whose favorite hobby is tormenting the weakest kids in class. But then Gray arrived. This mysterious new student threatens to dismantle the established order. He may be small in stature, but his calculative and brutal fighting leaves unsuspecting opponents lying on the floor begging for mercy. Now the school's toughest bullies have to scramble to take down this new and unusual hero. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Starring in gay porn was never on Ed's bucket list. He's straight, he's not an exhibitionist, and he has a decent career in security. That said, he also has a debt that he's been working to pay off for years now, and he can barely keep up with the accruing interest. If having gay sex in front of a camera is the way to digging himself out of this pit, then he's willing to be filmed for that money shot. But when he meets Glenn, the charismatic CEO of a gay porn production company, Ed finds himself falling into something much deeper than financial debt. Now, Ed is coming for the money...but will he be staying for Glenn?

(Source: Lezhin US)

After the death of his beloved girlfriend, police officer Kyungjoon just wants to be left alone to water his house plants and catch criminals. But after a police investigation into a mysterious cult goes supernatural, Kyungjoon finds himself unwillingly caught up in a world of demons, succubi and monsters - and the worst of them all is a demon king calling himself “Lord Cain.” It turns out that in order to survive, Cain needs mana that can only be accessed through a “door” inside Kyungjoon. The problem is… how is he planning to open that door?

*Source: Tappytoon*

---

After a devastating personal loss, Kyungjoon wants nothing more than to drown his grief in the silence and safety of his houseplants. But Kyungjoon is also a cop, and it’s a cop’s job to go after criminals.

One day, hot pursuit of a suspect leads to Kyungjoon discovering signs of cult activity. Soon, the policeman is caught up in the machinations of monsters and demons, the worst of which is the demon king, Lord Cain, whose survival in this world depends on mana that can only be accessed through a “door.” Cain’s door happens to be inside Kyungjoon, and these two will have to get up close and very personal to open it.

*Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, Vol. 1*

titles.title: Bộ chín vĩ đại của Heliopolis
ENNEAD เทวาบัลลังก์สวาท
九柱神 第一季 外傳：ENNEAD

description:
Nine powerful gods of ancient Egypt are known as the Ennead. When the god of war, Seth, kills his brother Osiris to take over Egypt, he ushers in an era of chaos and cruelty under his rule. The other gods are unable to fight Seth’s power until centuries later, when a new challenger appears: Horus, the child of Isis. Horus is not yet even a full god, but he’s backed by other deities to dethrone Seth and bring an end to the many years of bloodshed. The conflict between Seth and Horus that begins as a series of trials warps into a complex web of deceit, obsession...and even desire. 

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

titles.title: Red Candy y su dulce trampa
Red Candy ปฏิบัติการชิงหัวใจ
ปฏิบัติการชิงหัวใจ
キャンディトラップ～スパイの仕掛けた恋の罠

description:
Shi-Hyeon, aka “Red Candy,” is a secret agent whose code name comes from bathing in the blood of his marks on dangerous missions. Shi-Hyeon's tasked with seducing and obtaining intel from Ha-Jun, a hot college professor. Shi-Hyeon can disarm enemies, but didn’t expect to be disarmed himself by Ha-Jun’s own tight body. Now Shi-Hyeon's caught between loyalty to his spy agency and Ha-Jun. Can Red Candy survive the incoming wave of enemies and still indulge in the sweet ecstasy of Ha-Jun's embrace? 

(Source: Tapas) 

*Note: Includes eight extra chapters.*

titles.title: Biên Niên Sử Của Thiên Quỷ
重生之我在魔教耍长枪

description:
In an ancient world where martial artists reign supreme, Un-Seong can only watch as his master is brutally beaten to death after a false accusation of practicing forbidden demonic arts. Even after a valiant fight, he fails to kill those responsible and faces his own end. But fate has other plans… Instead of taking his last breath, he awakens as a child, training to be an elite soldier of a demonic sect. Now Un-Seong must embrace the demonic arts and harness power in his ultimate quest for revenge. 

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

titles.title: How I Found It in July
มหัศจรรย์รักวัยฝัน เดือนกรกฎาคม

description:
Dan-oh is an ordinary high school student experiencing some not-so-normal things. Days seem to pass in the blink of an eye, her memory's gone fuzzy, and she might be hallucinating. What’s going on? Turns out she’s a character in a popular romance comic! But no, she’s not the main character—she’s an extra with a terminal heart condition, engaged to a childhood friend who doesn’t love her and will eventually dump her. Frustrated by her limited time, Dan-oh sets out to find her true first love.

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Not having any friends is bad enough, but being swallowed by mysterious black sludge in the middle of class? The worst. Yijun is no stranger to solitude, until a school project plants the seed for a delicate bond with another loner, Suni. But friendship is a frustrating puzzle for those who are used to being alone, especially when one of them claims to control a black goo that only turns hostile when the host is gripped by anxiety. Will Yijun and Suni be able to open up and make something of their budding friendship? 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

*Note: It was one of five winners of the Today's Comic Award in 2019.*

titles.title: กู๊ดบาย นายญาติตัวร้าย

description:
In high school, he thought she was a bully and she thought he was a huge jerk. Years later, Han-Eol and Da-Hae meet again... because their siblings are getting married! But tragedy strikes the newlyweds and their loved ones are left to wonder how they could have saved them. Han-Eol and Da-Hae awake to find themselves in high school again—and their siblings are alive! With only each other and a diary to rely on, can they weave a new destiny for their siblings? Or will fate unravel all the same? 

(Source: Tapas, edited)

titles.title: มนุษย์ทมิฬ

description:
Being called a freak isn’t so bad when you have a spunky little black blob as a companion. An explosion leaves Nam Kang orphaned, scarred, and nearly blind, but he toughs out the daily bullying with the help of his imaginary blob friend, Inky. Until one day, Nam wakes from a bad beating to find his scars healed and his vision restored. At a new school, Nam is finally given the chance to live life as a normal kid. But it isn’t just his scars that have disappeared. His best friend Inky is gone, too. 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

titles.title: The Man Who Cleans Up Makeup
ตกหลุมรัก นายช่างแต่งหน้า
化粧を落としてくれる男子

description:
After years of being told to focus on studying, Yeseul feels lost when she starts college and is suddenly expected to pay attention to makeup. When a chance encounter with brilliant makeup artist Yuseong leads to her taking part in a televised makeup competition, Yeseul begins to question the role that makeup and appearance play in society. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: ชีวิตนักเรียนฉัน ขอคืนเถอะนะ

description:
Do you want a refund on your life? Start earning karma at The Refund High School to reincarnate as an ideal version of yourself. 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

description:
The worst calamity humankind has ever faced... 

Shadow Realms have ravaged the earth and decimated almost everyone in their way. The survival of humanity hinges upon the success of just six mages, including analytic fighter Desir Herrman. The remaining heroes make one final stand to end the bloodshed...but to no avail. Desir closes his eyes on what should be the end of his life—only to open them and see the beginning of his school days?! Desir has returned thirteen years back to the past, where he’s been given another chance. A chance to see the loved ones he lost, a chance to meet his fellow warriors again, and a chance to save the world…! 

(Source: Yen Press)

titles.title: A Love Contract with the Devil
Un Contrato De Amor Con El Diablo
สัญญาเดทกับซาตาน

description:
When a down-on-her-luck student runs out of money – and hope – it’s time for the devil to make his entrance and give her an offer she can’t refuse. But this devil has problems of his own. He’s a cog in Satan’s corporate ladder, who’s quickly losing credibility because that same desperate girl isn’t ready to part with her soul willingly. Now, she’s working at his coffee shop while he tries to convince her that she can have it all. And the cost? Merely her mortal soul… 

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: ความรักลับๆ ของนายแอปเปิ้ลเขียว
青蘋果樂園 第三季

description:
So you’ve decided to forget about your high-school crush after graduation, going on to college without ever telling them how you felt. That’s the plan for quiet college freshman Mae-Hwa Yang. But even the best laid plans can go astray, as Mae-Hwa discovers when he learns that his crush, Jae-Won Myeong, goes to the same college! As their lives begin to intertwine through the hustle and bustle of college life, old feelings get stirred up and new feelings start to emerge. 

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

titles.title: กรงรักบัลลังก์มังกร

description:
With the screech of rubber and a crunch of metal, Dojin departs the mortal world, leaving behind his beloved sister and niece. He awakens in the kingdom of Yooguk, where the people call him “emperor” and serve a god named Yellow Dragon. Dojin soon discovers that Yellow Dragon called him to Yooguk for a purpose: to share his “life force” and protect the kingdom. As Dojin slips deeper into Yellow Dragon’s cold embrace, how far will he go in order to get back home?

(Source: Lezhin)

titles.title: シベリアウサギと花屋の野獣

description:
As the saying goes - never judge a book by its cover. 

Da-Im is a lovely elementary school teacher, as well as a savage who can rip anyone apart with the fiercest comebacks. On-Gyum is a florist with a heart of gold, who often gets misunderstood because of his intimidating looks. But as incompatible as they seem, their shared love of cats starts pulling the unlikely pair closer together... Here comes an upbeat romantic comedy between a sassy bunny and a sweet beast! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

A human, lycan, or a vampire - what am I?! Completely unaware of the existence of these predators, Hwa-Gok goes about his everyday life... That is, until Lee-Bin turns his life upside down by biting him on the neck, setting off a whirlwind of events neither of them could foresee. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

反派女配角生存大作戰

description:
We all hate the greedy villains hell-bent on sabotage. Enter Carnelia Easter, the awful secondary villainess of the romance I’m reading, who trapped the prince in marriage at the behest of the evil empress. I didn’t shed a tear when her head’s lopped off, but now I’m Carnelia! I gotta play this smart and convince him to divorce me instead! Still, between the prince, the empress, the heroine, the second prince, my terrible health... this story’s getting unpredictable. Will I survive after all? 

(Source: Tapas)

titles.title: ซอมบี้ลูกพ่อ

description:
One year after an unprecedented zombie attack that killed hundreds of thousands, South Korea has finally been declared zombie-free. But Jeong-Hwan holds a secret: his daughter is the last zombie left on earth. When her cravings are satisfied and her violent tendencies die down, it almost seems like there’s hope for her to have a normal life. But how long can he keep Su-Ah a secret from everyone else?

(Source: WEBTOON)

description:
Meet the Skeleton Soldier, a meager but fiercely loyal fighter who serves to protect its master, Lady Succubus. Its dream of a peaceful life with her is shattered when they're both brutally murdered by a group of warriors one day. But what would’ve been a pathetic end to an unremarkable soul sparks a new beginning: when the Skeleton Soldier opens its eyes again, it has traveled back 20 years in time! “I must warn Lady Succubus of all the things to come!” But with no special combat skills and a history of failure and defeat, how can it stop the horrible events from unfolding again? Follow the Skeleton Soldier as it faces the most challenging quest of all—rewriting the ending to its own story.

(Source: TappyToon)

titles.title: Hãy Để Tôi An Ủi Cậu

description:
Dayeol hears two guys fooling around in the nurse’s office and accidentally knocks over the curtain rod. When the nurse walks in on the scene, devilishly handsome Taehyun tells her that Dayeol tried to make out with him. Before Dayeol can correct the misunderstanding, the rumor spreads and his archery scholarship is in jeopardy. To make matters worse, Taehyun doesn’t show the slightest bit of remorse; in fact, he shamelessly begins hanging around Dayeol. It’s not long before the two begin walking the thin line between hate and love. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: โอ้! นายผู้ช่วยของผม

description:
Seonho in an artist, who draws adult webcomics. It started as an easy way to make money, but it’s caused some unexpected side effects: he hasn’t been aroused for over two years! Exhausted, he hires an assistant. It’s just that, he didn’t expect him to be so cute! Muyeong is clean, talented, and apparently loaded so...why does he want to work under Seonho? Turns out, Muyeong is Seonho’s number one fan… 

(Source: Tapas)

titles.title: Majesty, What Do You Want to Be?
Prince, What Do You Want to Be?
What Do You Want to Be, Prince?

description:
"If you wrote me, then you can give me the throne!" 

Yoonsoo is the successful author of a popular fantasy series. Just as she's about to start work on a new series, Imperial Prince Kyte Einzen, the worst villain she created has kidnapped her into the world of her own story?! Can she mold this nightmare into a story that will turn both their fates around? Based on the hit novel.

(Source: Tappytoon)

titles.title: インナー・ビューティー

description:
Min-Jae’s been dumped. Fed up with their long distance relationship, his actress girlfriend Hye-Eun left him while he was “finding himself” in Australia. When Min-Jae rushes home and runs into Hye-Eun and her gorgeous new man, Woo-Chan, at the airport, drama ensues. Amidst the chaos, the two love rivals bang heads. Upon waking, they discover they’ve changed bodies! Why have they switched? How will they cope? Will they ever be able to go back? Find out as Min-Jae and Woo-Chan embark on a journey that takes “self-discovery” to a whole new level! 

(Source: Lezhin)

titles.title: อ้อมกอดร้อนซ่อนไอรัก

description:
Every day of Giovanni’s life has been cold. Despite scorching summers, sunny springs, despite being the president of an uber rich company, he is incapable of feeling warmth, numb to it all. Then, he met Felix. Shy and seemingly innocent, Felix’s touch is the first heat Giovanni’s felt in a lifetime. Lust or love, Giovanni hires him as his personal bodyguard, but are Felix’s true motives so warmhearted? 

(Source: Tapas) 

*Note: Includes 30 side story chapters.*

titles.title: It's Mine เธอเป็นของฉัน

description:
There’s nothing that Yo-Han Do doesn’t know about his crush, Da-Jeong. Where she sits in class, works after school... and even where she lives. But unable to approach her, he watches her every move from afar and will do anything to protect her. Anything. 

*"What can I do to get closer to you?"*

Today, just like yesterday, Yo-Han Do is watching. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

By day Bo-Ram Eom is a secretary, but by night she’s secretly a children’s storybook author under the pen name Bo-Ram. Too talented to be just an office worker, she created The Child with A Mask to escape her terrible boss, Se-Hu Kwon. Sure, he’s attractive, intelligent, but he’s also super rude! And now, he wants to find the creator of the book. How long can she keep her identity secret? And why does her boss want to meet her… 

(Source: Tapas, edited)

titles.title: นายสุภาพบุรุษ

description:
What’s it like spending your whole life coming in second place?

Ask Nam Jinwoo, he’s been living in the shadow of his rival, Ma Sangtae, his whole life. From high school to college, and now in the office. But passion is strange, it can start as envy or hate and turn into something… erotic. Now Jinwoo’s head is filled with the dirtiest and most erotic thoughts, none of which are in his control. More than anything, he wants them to stop. But the only way to stop them might just be the last thing he wants to do…

(Source: Lezhin)

*Note: Includes 29 extra chapters.*

titles.title: Bí mật của nhân viên văn phòng K
ความลับของพนักงาน K

description:
Mr. Doyun Kim’s a pretty quiet, unassuming guy at the office — with a big secret. He’s actually half vampire! But without full vamp status, he can’t drink blood and has to seek out some human essence (read: sex! and more sex!) to live. Drained and desperate, he finds a “special” companion but everything goes wrong. Now he’s caught up in a one-sided office relationship, and most importantly, it’s not working!!! Will Doyun survive and keep his secret intact?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.*

Hae-Soo is a cynical writer of a romance column, while Joo-Won, his former stepbrother, is a famous actor. The two go way back - thrust together when their parents remarried, their relationship is far from simple. Brothers? Soulmates? Friends with benefits? Or nothing at all? Theirs is a delicate balance between lust and loathing, dating and breaking up, irritation and infatuation. 

When the mysterious photographer “K” takes an interest in Hae-Soo, events begin to spiral out of control. As the lines between art and reality become increasingly blurred, what direction will this story take? Cheap romance? Sensual erotica? Or something much more twisted?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

description:
This is Table Land, a mystical world where fallen shooting stars take the form of a witch and are bound to a cat, so when the witch dies, so will the cat. This story begins with a witch's end, but with her still-living cat left behind, and another witch who fell from the skies, soon left alone by the death of her guardian. Forlorn, they both start their lonely search for a place to belong. Will the shadows of the past loom or will the light of hope shine bright? Embark with us now on this curious tale of Table Land...

(Source: Tapas)

titles.title: Back to School: All Grown Up

description:
Chi-Woo’s got issues. Upon returning to school after the “incident” last year, he vows to keep to himself and stay out of trouble until graduation. Easier said than done: his bad boy reputation has made him the talk of the school, and Kyu-Jin - class president and model student - won’t stop being friendly. Trouble arrives soon enough in the shape of Ji-Hyun, a tattooed hunk from Chi-Woo’s dark past. It’s gonna be a tough year… 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Then one day, as Jin-Kyung was no-lifing as usual, he was summoned to ‘Another World’, and came face-to-face with a bright-eyed, hopeful Summoner… Interesting enough, in the world that Jin-Kyung was summoned to, his Social Anxiety Disorder disappeared, and he was also able to wield immense power, and became the strongest summoned being there ever was!! Liliana Pence's world as a naive, young noblewoman changes upon meeting Edward Carter, a commoner with an agenda of his own. Oblivious to his scorn for her, Liliana dreams of being together with him, until her dreams are shattered by her arranged marriage. Desperate to avoid the union, she confesses to Edward, only to have him coldly reject her and disappear. When Liliana's fortunes take a turn for the worse and she loses everything, the two reunite... but in a way neither expects. 

(Source: Tapas)

The last surviving omega, and the man who desperately needs him! Fifty years go, a virus sweeps through the world, wiping out all the omegas from the face of the earth. Rain, the sole surviving omega, lives his whole life hiding his identity - until he accidentally runs into Lukas. As the chairman of the facility that used to produce artificial omegas, Lukas has to produce an alpha heir in order to succeed his father's business. And while he has his mind set on winning Rain over, things don't seem to go so smoothly... 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes 16 extra chapters.*

titles.title: ริกซ์ เวนุส

description:
The handsome and strapping Prince Rix Vanus has returned to his homeland after winning a brutal war against demons! And yet... Cursed by a vicious demon, the warrior prince is tormented nightly with shameful, lust-filled hallucinations as the demon takes the lascivious form of all his associates. 

Escaping to the wild, miraculously, a benevolent divine spirit named Nuah joins the prince, seeking to break the curse and ease his suffering. And now, his nights —and more— are filled with Nuah. 

(Source: Tapas)

Korea’s hunkiest top model Woo Tae-Young has decided to try his hand at acting once more. No more of those teen heartthrob roles, Tae-Young has his eyes set on a much more…mature role. And when he finds out his idol, the dreamy Koo Min-Ki, is set to be one of the main actors of the film, he is even more determined to get the role as his co-star. The two seem to have a natural chemistry with each other… both on and off screen. Will this end up helping their performances? Or will it cause their worlds to come crashing down? 

(Source: Lezhin)

 *Notes:
\- The main story finished with chapter 84 which was published in March.
\- Total chapter count includes 11 extras and 3 epilogues (one per season and one for the extras).*

The ugly loser completely changes after he meets a "savior"! Will he finally get a girlfriend? 

(Source: Toomics)

Hans is a student from Korea who moved to San Francisco to study art. Emily is a sassy princess from the Flower Kingdom who’s plays pranks and gets bored like anybody else. She is also a goldfish. This is the beginning of a modern fantasy love story set in San Francisco. 

(Source: Tapas) 

*Note: The chapter count includes a prologue and an epilogue.*

titles.title: ホスト DE 一発逆転

description:
Na Bonggu's a professional when it comes to pleasing women - which makes him the perfect host (ie. gigolo). After a night spent in a motel with a rich female client, he's approached by someone he presumes is a female con-artist: Seulbi. Turns out Seulbi's got a connection that can help him pay off his 3 million dollar debt. The two of them meet a Madam Hong, who tasks them with seducing five wealthy ladies. But the job isn't without its dangers: Bonggu and Seulbi are forced to wear shock collars outfitted with a tracking device. They must complete their mission... or pay the price.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Although Ilene Jung is a popular webtoon artist, she needs another job. A crappy desk job to be exact, one tyrannically controlled by the meanest manager in the world: Jim Kang. He insults her work, refuses to teach her, and even makes her miss an important appointment by forcing her work late on her very first day. To make things worse, when Jim applies to become an artist’s assistant, the artist turns out to be Ilene! In a begrudging twist of fate, she accepts him and the two enter a bizarre working relationship both at home and at the office. How long can it last? Why is Ilene working a desk job? And who’s the boss here anyways?! 

(Source: Tapas)

titles.title: ケッコン：インポッシブル

description:
What would you do for $500k? As a struggling actress, I agreed to play the part of Doting Fiancée to Jeekyung Lee, a charming, handsome heir to a Korean conglomerate—the perfect husband! Except, he’s gay. Eh, it’s fine! The only problem is... (cue ominous music) Jeehan, Jeekyung’s younger brother. That jerk may have the looks of a leading man, but he’s determined to show I’m the wrong girl for Jeekyung! It’s gonna take the performance of my life to win him over. Hah! I’m ready for my Oscar! 

(Source: Tapas)

Lindsay is a top-secret spy about to take on her most difficult mission yet: to disguise herself as a man?! Her target is the Duke. Rich, mysterious, and… an infamous womanizer. Cutting her hair, drinking elixirs to hide her voice, as a servant she must infiltrate his manor and investigate the mysterious disappearance of lords and ladies in the area. However, when she meets the Duke for the first time and he kisses her, is it her identity that's compromised or her heart…

(Source: Tapas)

Eight participants, 100 days, and a shared pot of money amounting to 44.8 billion won (around 38 million USD). This is Money Game, a reality TV show, where participants try to spend as little as possible to walk away with as much as they can. Marooned in a specially designed TV set with nothing but a set of clothes and a rule book, every item they purchase is 1,000 times the original price. How much money will the participants manage to keep?

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: My High School Romance Side Story
วัยเรียน วัยรักของผม

description:
Two people who hate to lose, in love?!

*“Let’s go out with me, not my brother.”*

I just wanted to get to know him, but he suddenly came to me asking me to go out with him instead of hyung, so I agreed thinking that I would make him try really hard. However, once we get to know each other, unexpected feelings begin to arise... a tight and sweet love battle between two male high schoolers who cannot back down. 

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

titles.title: 鬼胎 〜幽霊と人間の子ども〜

description:
Jo Seong-Jae has a secret: he’s been spending passionate nights with a ghost that looks like Hong Do-Hui, the man he’s in love with. Plagued every night by his yearning and the unrelenting ghost, Seong-Jae’s health steadily worsens. Concerned for his ailing friend, Do-Hui offers to help Seong-Jae escape his nightmares. It’s a feat no ordinary man could accomplish, but Do-Hui is no ordinary man. See, Do-Hui has a secret, too. It just might be the key to saving Seong-Jae…or to destroying them both.

(Source: Lezhin)

*Note: Chapter count includes 18 extras.*

titles.title: รักนี้เกินห้ามใจ [Nevertheless]

description:
What happens when a girl who wants to date but doesn't believe in love meets a guy who likes to flirt but thinks relationships are a drag? That's how it is for Na-Bi and Jae-Eon, two art students who meet in college and develop a strong connection -- inspired by butterflies. As they get to know each other and their relationship progresses, they'll face the early stages of attraction and the ups and downs of dating. This story will make you long to be in a relationship -- even when you know it won't be easy. 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Jung-Ho is bullied to the point of self-harm, until one day, his prayers are answered by Mephistopheles, the archdevil. Mephisto offers Jung-Ho magical powers that would allow him to take revenge on his bullies, and in return, asks for his soul. It’s an easy choice for Jung-Ho, who thinks nothing can be worse than the living hell that is his life. But what he doesn’t know is that there are greater forces at work, and that he is but a pawn in a much larger game played by angels, demons, and exorcists.

(Source: Lezhin)

titles.title: エロティック・サイコ

description:
As a reporter, Clark has interviewed many criminals but never a murderer. Enter Alex, the Triage Killer. A serial killer who kills in three, he agrees to an interview so long as Clark offers one thing in return: himself. Murder after murder, question after question, Clark will learn why Alex kills. And Alex… he will learn Clark isn’t as innocent as he seems. 

(Source: Tapas)

titles.title: ネカマ相手はクラスメイト？！

description:
Kyuyeon has an alternative persona in the online game, he pretends to be a female player with a character named “Yorong” only to rip off items from other clueless users. One of “Her” diehard fan named “Yeommin” showers Kyuyeon with gifts day and night. He’s happy but at the same time, Kyuyeon feels a bit pressured about Yeommin because he’s always asking “Yorong” for a date. To top it all, Kyuyeon finds out that Yeommin is his handsome classmate Kimin Yeom. How is he going to get out of this trouble?

(Source: PocketComics)

titles.title: พี่ชายของผมเท่ที่สุด

description:
As the youngest member of hit idol group LoverU, Ryeojoon never suspected that a book gifted by a fan would be... riveting fan fiction starring himself and the other LoverU members! Drawn deeper into the mysterious world of fanfics, he just can't stop himself anymore... How long can this bookworm keep his not-so-innocent hobby a secret? Superstar turns superfan as Ryeojoon walks a dangerous line between idol and fanboy!

(Source: Tappytoon) 

*Note: Includes a prologue.*

The delinquent, Yang Kangwoo, who’s only wasting time dating around and the part-timer at a maid cafe, Isaac’s love story.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/isac_yang/?p_id=fb2476), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/leesaks_sheep), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000056074), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9498444)

Geonyeong Yoon is the ace pitcher of the professional baseball team, “Embo Elephants”. One day, the team mascot, Funz the Elephant, starts to bother him. The strange war of nerves between the two slowly transforms into something else.

(Source: Lalatoon)

Isaeng and Jeongto were inseparable childhood friends until Jeongto’s father died tragically at the hands of a bitter soul. These two friends reunite ten years later as adversaries: Isaeng guides souls to the afterlife, while Jeongto gives souls another chance to live. After all this time, can these two work out their issues? And what do the Kings of Hell have to do with all of this? 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

What if you developed superpowers that could change your life only to discover that these incredible abilities only worked on… animals? When you’re teenager Jin Lee, that’s a pretty strange concept to wrap your head around – especially when you wish your destructive powers could help you overcome the bullies who torment you at school instead. But Jin is quickly learning that there’s a place in this world for a special individual like him – and he’s definitely not the only one of his kind out there. 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

titles.title: 悪戯なアイツは吸血鬼？

description:
On the night of a full moon, Do-Gyeong runs into a vampire with blood dripping from the corners of his mouth. Haunted by the encounter, he tries to dismiss it as a dream...but not only does the vampire go to the same school as him, he begins following him around everywhere! Do-Gyeong is horrified of course, but as time passes, he discovers some peculiar quirks about the creature: he prefers his meat well done, flinches at the sight of cats, and loves to cuddle. Who is this mysterious vampire, and why is he so fixated on Do-Gyeong? 

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

The hot new guy in Min-Soo's department turns out to be none other than his childhood friend, Jun-Won. But Jun-Won thinks of Min-Soo as more than a friend. Finally craving into Jun-Won's persistent advances, Min-Soo agrees to go out with him for one semester. While Min-Soo's plan is to make Jun-Won grow sick of him during that time, will Min-Soo succeed? Or will Jun-Won manage to win Min-Soo over?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and seven extras.*

Ho-Su, who used to move a lot because of his parents work, finds a strange door in their new house. And he meets Seung-U, a boy of the same age who lives across the door.

The two boys, who shared a mysterious experience, began to come and go through the door. Warm air permeates between the two like a late afternoon. And slowly another secret grows in the hearts of the boys.... 

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

A story full of mean girls and violence. A young boy trying to rise above his surroundings, and a rich girl trying to stay on top. Will the Queen be able to keep her throne?

(Source: DAYcomics)

Our story begins with Ji-Gyo, the crown prince, having recently been exiled from the palace with a guard, Dan-Geum, and the man who raised him, Chunggeum. The three are forced to pass their remaining days in a quiet village made up of mostly elderly residents. This leads to a listless and lonely Ji-Gyo, who begins pressing Dan-Geum to relieve his traditional post as a voiceless shadow, and the two quickly grow closer. Hints of a bloody conspiracy, Dan-Geum’s mysterious origin, and Chunggeum who seems to know more than he's letting on - just how are these three characters connected, and what will happen to them during exile? 

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

*Note: Includes eight extra chapters.*

Woohyun is, for lack of a better word, normal. He’s not rich, looks sorta regular, and isn't overly smart. Add that all up and you’ve got a guy who women look at and go, “Meh.” But somehow, he’s scored the hottest girl on campus, Moon Ina. Long blonde hair, legs that go on forever and… let’s just say that when she walks by, men feel the unexpected need to cover their pelvis.
Unfortunately, all of Woohyun’s sexual experiences with women have been of the digital or imaginary variety. So when his childhood friend, Ha-eun, shows up and offers him free lessons, he… totally shuts her down. Because, honestly, how hard could it be?

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.*

titles.title: Keep Holding On〜8年越しの片思い？〜

description:
8 years is a long time to have a crush. Doubly so if that crush is your own best friend. Han-gyeol is tired of his own heartsickness for his childhood friend Sooho, and he thinks that maybe it's about time for him to let go of these feelings. He's contemplating moving on, but there's something inside of him that can't help but cling to this crush. Will there be a reward waiting for Han-gyeol if he keeps holding on, or will it only end in heartbreak? 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

titles.title: Conrad จักรพรรดิกับอัศวินมังกร

description:
The dark ages of oppression and fear had ended and the era of the peaceful reign of Bayern Agentiland Haus III had begun. Jayden, a knight who had returned home from his military service, happened to pick up a mysterious "egg" while wandering the street. Jayden tried to eat the egg, but out popped a dragon! He was destined to be the babysitter of the dragon from then on. An emperor, who finds himself distrusting of dragons because of 'Hydra', the dragon that caused terror throughout the Dark Ages... Jayden, a knight who finds himself taking care of a dragon out of the blue... What will happen in their future?! Enjoy this Romance Fantasy BL story between Bayern, the emperor, and Jayden, the knight accompanied by Conrad, the dragon!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

*Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.*

titles.title: 金曜22時、視界を奪って犯して－赤の領域－

description:
“If you ever develop feelings for me, then show me the face behind the blindfold…” Baek Myeongdo has never been particularly good with people but, fortunately, he’s also never really cared. Relationships are confusing, messy, and Myeongdo would really rather just avoid them all-together. Still, he finds it awfully hard to resist a beautiful pair of hands when he sees one... When Chung Oak accepts his proposition to meet him in a hotel one night, Myeongdo’s plan is to never see him again. However, Oak finds this mysteriously blindfolded man far more intriguing than he’d anticipated. Soon, their “one night only” becomes many nights and often, but just what will it take for Oak to make it beyond Myeongdo’s self-imposed limits? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: Don't Forget That I Like You
Don’t Forget that You Like Me
Đừng quên rằng em thích anh
ルームメイトはイケメンに弱い

description:
Jungmin is a sucker for hotties. Boy or girl, he doesn’t care - he goes all weak in the knees when he sees a pretty face. At the freshmen welcome party, a guy catches his eye from across the room. Tall, cool and drop dead gorgeous, Jiho is just his type. But he’s a freshman while Jungmin’s a sophomore, and a returning student at that. Little does Jungmin know that from the moment he lays eyes on this irresistible freshman, his ordinary life will slowly begin to change! 

(Source: Lezhin)

titles.title: 悪霊狩猟団：カウンターズ

description:
In this world and the next, both good and evil exist. But who do you call when evil spirits from the afterlife escape to prey on innocent human lives? You call the Counters, people with supernatural abilities, who also happen to run a noodle shop. When one's killed, an ordinary high school student is unexpectedly chosen to take their place. The seemingly mundane life of So Mun takes a drastic turn as his body changes (curly hair now included) and he starts to show a talent for his new role. 

(Source: Tapas)

titles.title: คิดถึงนะ ลูซิเฟอร์

description:
An A-list star has a crush on a rookie idol.

Jung-Woo 'Lucifer' Lee, a member of the obscure idol group Sweet Devils, dreams of making it big. His one claim to fame — an accidental pants-ripping on air — leads to a chance encounter with A-list star Kwon-Jun Kang. Turns out, Kwon-Jun has been harboring an intense crush on Lucifer. What will happen when an unexpected one-night stand leads to an ambiguous romance? How will this A-list star and D-list idol navigate their relationship? 

(Source: Manta)
One day, in the middle of summer, it suddenly starts to snow. What sort of changes will the snow bring?

As far as anyone can tell, Jae-Hee is a shy, hard-working high school teacher. Once she's behind closed doors and drawn curtains, Jae-Hee enjoys spending her time kneeling at the end of a whip. And no one enjoys holding the handle more than her childhood friend, Hui-Lin. But when Sul-Hwa starts her position as a student-teacher at the school, secrets and feelings long buried start to surface. Now, Jae-Hee's about to learn just how much pleasure she can pull from pain.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

titles.title: I Gave Birth to a Dog
I Gave Birth to a Dog: From Parting to Meeting

description:
Da-Na is a freelance illustrator who feels lonely and stressed out from working all day and doing little else. But this all changes when she is joined by a new four-legged friend: a small pomeranian puppy called Myeong-Dong. This cute little pup shows her what unconditional love looks like, and Da-Na does her best to look after her new pal, too. 

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Hojun possesses a unique ability to see a sign above people's heads - those that he is attracted to! When Hojun saw the sign above the famous Woosung's head, he feels the need to save this person. Romance between the two unlikely classmates blooms as they begin to get to know more about the other.

(Source: INKR)

After losing all hope of finding love, Ha-eun doesn't see the point of carrying on...until one day, a mysterious being saves her life and promises to make her irresistible to any man. Its method is unorthodox to say the least, but it sure makes her feel good. 2nd Lezhin Comics Big Comic Contest Prize Winner.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Welcome to Daughters Adult Video Rental Store! We have just the kink you’re looking for. Like it in a public place? What about on a bus? Maybe with a stranger? Or a student with his teacher? Nothing is too crazy for this place. My sisters and I are in charge of this shop. And we’re always willing to give you the perfect recommendation that suits your taste. So, what do you like? We know the best video to make you come again and again!

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: I Stack Experience Through Reading Books
I Stack Experience Through Writing Books
Kono Hon wa Boku no Keiken-chi o Unda
من از کتاب نوشتن، تجربه کسب می‌کنم
من با نوشتن در کتاب، تجربه می‌گیرم
この本は僕の経験値を生んだ
この本は僕の経験値を生んだ

description:
Jongsuk is the pinnacle of mediocrity, with nothing to show for himself except his penchant for reading. One day, he finds a mysterious book at his favorite used book store. The book "tells" him to write about his experience in its blank pages, and in return shows him a related piece of information. Little did he know, the passages Jongsuk read in the books transferred right into his system, endowing with new abilities he never thought possible. 

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Cho-eul and Ju-ah have been BFFs since childhood. In high school, they shared a kiss, but it was only because Cho-eul said she was bored. They’ve continued to be inseparable, but only as friends. Deep inside, Ju-ah wants things to be different and even Cho-eul senses - and toys with - this unspoken tension. So how close is too close? What would happen if besties crossed the fine line between friends... and desire? 

(Source: Tapas)

titles.title: บุรุษไร้ชีวิต

description:
Jun Ha is a genius surgeon with the highest success rate in his operations and has a special ability to see the lifespan of a person he faces. Sekwang, a ruthless gangster, mistakes Jun for a hitman and digs his past. Strangely Jun can't see Sekwang's lifespan and becomes curious about him. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: JUSQU'À CE QUE NOS LÈVRES S'EFFLEURENT

description:
Seo-U Jeong (Sebastian Jung) was the hottest teacher, that is, until I-Geon Han (Isaac Han) arrived. Tall, intelligent, and beautifully brooding, I-Geon has it all and Seo-U knows this all too well. In the past, they had shared a sultry after school romance. Now, I-Geon is back. Can Seo-U resist falling for I-Geon again or will his lips yearn for his touch? 

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Seorim was working at a laboratory as a scientist, but…it turns out he’s not especially good at following directions. After exploding some very expensive equipment, his boss gives him the chance to make amends (read: pay him back) by working as a spy in a competitor’s lab. It’s a dream come true! Professor Gong is renowned as a genius innovator and he’s just hired Seorim to work in his lab. Part of his job is testing new products, but just what he’ll be testing in Professor Gong’s lab may be more surprising than the fact that he was hired at all. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: What Do You Take Me For?
mangabaka_title: What Do You Take Me For?

titles.title: What Do You Take Me For?

description:
When your annoying friend asks if you have a girlfriend, you might as well lie about it right? But what happens when you actually start getting into a relationship with the girl you lied about? One young man is about to experience that whirlwind...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

titles.title: กระซิบรักซ่านหัวใจ

description:
I only called to complain about the issue with my product… Yeong-Ha fell in love with the voice of the customer service operator. What if the man with that same voice appears in front of Yeong-Ha?! Yeong-Ha had just found the voice of his dreams. Eun-Seong, a man with a perfect and dreamy voice, who'd rather devote himself to work than be in a relationship. Seon-Nam, owner of the adult shop, "Adult Angel." Seon-Su, Yeong-Ha's first crush and judo athlete! A romantic love square between the three men and Yeong-Ha! 

(Source: Wutopia Comics, edited) 

*Note: Includes nine extra chapters.*

titles.title: As If I've Never Been Hurt
As If You've Never Been Hurt
Han Beon-do Sangcheo Batji Aneun Geot-cheoreom
Будто бы тебе никогда не было больно

description:
Does love really last forever? 

College student Izzy Noh thinks her loving relationship with her boyfriend Minsu will last forever… until he cheats on her. To make things worse, they are not only in the same school, but in the same Game Developer Club. Izzy must now navigate handling the breakup, dealing with her feelings, and possibly opening up to another shot at love. Will Izzy and her friends from the Game Developer Club find true campus love? 

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: บทรักกวนใจนายซุป'ตาร์
二律背反～ベッドの上では演技が本気になる。

description:
Cha-Min is an A-list actor with a talent for reading lines — AND people’s thoughts. Mo-Gyum is an actor getting his career back on track after a mysterious accident left him scarred as a kid. The relentless Cha-Min can’t read scene-partner Mo-Gyum's thoughts at all, making him all the more intriguing... He can't get in his head, but that doesn’t stop him from trying to get inside his body. After all, they're just rehearsing the drama... The scenes heat up as the clothes come off between these two! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: An Erection Filled Life with the Mother-In-Law
Kayınvalidem İle Ereksiyon Dolu Bir Hayat
嶽母家的刺激生活/上門女婿

description:
A 34 year old man ends up marrying a 20 year old girl, whose mother is… his teenage crush?!

(Source: Toomics)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

titles.title: Bạn Có Biết Về Thiên Thần Hộ Mệnh Không
ด้วยรักและภูตจิ๋ว

description:
Eun-Oh is always alone because of his peculiar ability to see fairies. But one day, Jae-Hwi, a transfer student, comes up to Eun-Oh without hesitation! "When I'm with you, I feel good," he said, shaking Eun-Oh's heart. 

(Source: Lezhin, translated) 

*Note: Chapter count includes three extra chapters.*

titles.title: My dream of being in a school filled with women, is finally coming true!! But wait.. Do they really think I’m a girl?

description:
A school filled with woman! But wait... Do they really think i'm a girl too?!!

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: There Is No Fantasy For Alice

description:
A mysterious girl, Alice, falls from the sky. Brace yourselves because this is not the tale of Alice we all know. 

(Source: Toomics) 

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

An orphan, Hanyul didn’t have much in life but a dream to become a singer. That is, till he saw his best friend mercilessly murdered by someone he looked up to. Harold. Popular. Perfect. Psychopath. And rich enough to cover his tracks. On the run, Hanyul quits high school, changing his name with every new job he scrambles together. When a famous singer hears his voice and offers a chance at revenge, one question remains: can he sing? 

(Source: Tapas)

Kang Haru, also known as Kay-D from the popular idol group 'Miracle Knights', is running away from his life of fame... but what will he find on this charming little island?

(Source: Toomics)

The top dog of Busan is moving to Seoul. Will he be able to take over the new city?

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: As Long as You Like It
Con tal de que te guste
До тех пор, пока вам это нравится
Քանի դեռ ձեզ դուր է գալիս
ดั่งใจปรารถนา

description:
To help Lady Selene avoid an unwanted marriage, the feisty maid Dian travels to the secluded Evenhart Castle in her stead and with her name! As she buys time for Selene, Dian seeks refuge with the Margrave, said to be a direct descendant of the legendary knight Sir Evenhart (Dian’s a BIG fan~). But even though he’s extraordinarily handsome, he’s as cold as ice. Somehow he agrees to let her stay a few days. Will her secrets (and his) be revealed? And could love blossom by the lake once again?

(Source: Tapas)

After landing her dream job in TV, Doah can't be more excited... until she loses her loved ones in a shocking twist of events. While looking for a new place to stay, she stumbles across a promising ad for a share house and meets the Landlord, an oddball who seems like he's from another planet. But the shabby old-fashioned house is completely different from what Doah expected, and so are its two strange tenants: a prudish Joseon-era scholar from 1777 and a jolly Modern Boy from 1930. What's more, the Landlord seems determined to keep them from leaving for some mysterious reason. What crazy adventures await Doah in this house that transcends time, and will her rotten luck turn around for the better? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

But with the sudden confession from a childhood friend, her life spirals into the extraordinary – Hwanhee’s the descendant of powerful vampires and next in line to become the queen of vampire society! 

(Source: TappyToon) 

*Note: chapter count contains a prologue*

Mujin is a half-demon who transforms in and out of his demon form, Lewellyn. But when he reunited with his old friend Eunil, Mujin finds out that their relationship may be headed in a different direction...

(Source: Toomics)

Woo-Hyun is rich, good-looking and popular… but he also happens to be a total bully. His punching bag is Ha-Yan, a stuttering and amenable girl in his class. Woo-Hyun likes nothing more than harassing her… The weird thing is, Ha-Yan actually seems to crave his attention, feeding off it. As they each spin a web of deceit to ensnare the other, who will end up getting caught? And could romance bloom from this tangled, thorny mass of obsession? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

A struggling cupid candidate Tae-Hwa goes through series of tests to finally become a cupid but his troubling past is holding him back. His test partner Dan-Baek, an elite student, dismisses Tae-Hwa for being a bad student but finds out the true story of Tae-Hwa and how he became a cupid candidate... 

(Source: Pocket Comics) 

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and an extra.*

titles.title: ハッピーメリーエンディング

description:
Seungjun works part-time singing congratulatory songs at weddings, and Jaehyun quit his job to work as an emcee for a wedding hall. The two end up crossing paths by chance. Will the talkative and personable Jaehyun be able to ruffle the feathers of the usually calm and collected Seungjun?

(Source: Lezhin)

Social outcast Yeonhui dreams of fitting in with her schoolmates. But her social status doesn’t seem like it’s going to change anytime soon -- until an alien named I-an falls out of the sky and crashes into her hopeless life. He helps her transform herself, and she ends up in an exciting love triangle. Will Yeon-Hui choose I-An, the alien who helped her learn the true meaning of happiness, or Han-Je, the human boy who has been secretly protecting her before I-An appeared in her life? 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

*Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.*

Old friends get together and share their stories about the lady in their life. From the way they tell it, it sounds like a fantasy, too good to be true.

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: My Brother and I Are Rivals?!

description:
A not-so-beautiful love story between a woman and a pair of siblings caught in a complex love triangle.

During her monotonous days as a part-timer in a cafe, amateur photographer Hyeon-U meets a beautiful woman named Hui-Eun.

Secretly taking photos of the woman - who appears at the same time and sits in the same place - is the only thing that makes Hyeon-U’s world continue moving. However, after a week of her secret hobby, Hyeon-U’s eyes meet the woman’s across the viewfinder. What will happen to Hyeon-U now?

(Source: POCKET COMICS, edited)

titles.title: ดอกไม้ของแวมไพร์

description:
In a world where humans and vampires struggle to coexist, Seoyoung is just trying to live a peaceful life, spending time with her high school friends and working part-time at the flower shop. But that all changes when she crosses paths with Louie, an ancient and powerful vampire who needs her help hunting down the mystical "Vampire Flower" before it falls into the wrong hands. Suddenly thrown into a deadly battle between humans and monsters, Seoyoung will begin to unravel long-hidden secrets and sinister schemes as she tries to help Louie find what he’s been looking for all along...

(Source: Tappytoon) 

*Note: The chapter count includes a prologue.*

Dojun is a pretty ordinary guy. He’s a laid-back college student with a decent amount of friends and no notable scandals or troubles in his life. On the other hand, Haemin is his exact opposite: a fellow student with zero friends and a scandalous reputation with financial troubles following him wherever he goes. It’s really not the kind of lifestyle Dojun wants to be involved in. And yet, he can’t stop worrying about the perpetually bruised Haemin, which is why Dojun ends up worming his way into Haemin’s life…only to discover that there’s much more to him than the scandals say. Will Dojun be able to find the real Haemin buried under the injuries and rumors? 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: The chapter count includes two bonus chapters.*

titles.title: ความลับของขันที

description:
Heo Doh is the first prince in line for the crown, but everybody seems to favor his younger brother over him. Even his newly promoted eunuch, Hae-Min, sneaks off to spend time with the younger prince. When Heo Doh walks past Hae-Min’s quarters early one morning, he happens to witness the eunuch doing something thought to be impossible: masturbating while moaning the younger prince’s name. The possessive and jealous Heo Doh questions Hae-Min, but he denies that event ever took place. So, Heo Doh makes it his mission to prove that Hae-Min isn’t impotent after all...

(Source: Lezhin US)

One year after I left, the girl I knew committed suicide. I'm going to get revenge on you all. Just wait.

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: ระยะอันตรายหัวใจยัยตัวแสบ

Song Yoonjoo is an ambitious woman who is highly recognized at her work. She avoids having any kind of love affair in the office, yet a guy named Koo Jaehee, someone she ran into on the street and found attractive, joins her team at work as a new member. Since then, she finds herself slowly falling in love with him, and an emotional tug-of-war at this workplace starts between the two.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Woo-Hee is a freshman girl who’s majoring in computer science. One day, she went to a bar that she has never been before, and she ran into a guy there. 

*“Excuse me, sir. I think I know you....”* 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

titles.title: 彼女のヒールを脱がせたら

description:
Jin-U works at his uncle's shoe services, collecting and servicing shoes. What he didn't know, was that the offices nearby were filled with beautiful women.

An ex-boxing champion, starts to work as a private limo driver for escorts, and soon falls for his client, a high-end hooker. He has no idea that this would lead him right into the middle of a grand criminal scheme.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

童貞さん! その妄想、安美ちゃんに丸見えですよ!?

description:
Ami has a special ability: she can see the dirty fantasies of virginal men. The ability is more of a curse than a blessing, and she she’s never once reaped any benefits from being able to peek into other men’s obscene thoughts. But things take a turn when she finds herself having her own x-rated fantasies…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Prom, a member of K-Pop group Destiny, has a secret. In his past life, he was Prometheus, cursed by Zeus for eternity to fear fire. This curse keeps messing with him—he can’t even blow out birthday candles! But one day he meets Sora, a college student, at a fan signing and recognizes her as Pandora! He knows Pandora’s box can save him, but she has no clue what he’s talking about. With his acting debut as a fireman at stake, will Sora remember who she is and extinguish Prom’s fears for good? 

(Source: Tapas)

Joseph lived an ordinary life and it all took a turn when he realized he was being stalked. First, his school, then his locker, his phone and eventually his home- every aspect of his life was infiltrated by his stalker. Joseph is at his wits' end when Glen, a stranger, steps into his life at just the right moment and offers him a helping hand.

When your wife is always too tired to have sex, it builds up inside. What is a man to do when his beautiful coworkers at the office seem all too eager to help him release some of that stress? But be careful what you wish for... ? 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

titles.title: シークレットカノジョ

description:
College is supposed to be for fun, learning, and experiencing new things. One of these things could be witnessing your TA and professor getting it on. And what about this new freshman? She might be interested in me...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

After the suspicious suicide of his older brother Gaeul, Haneul decides enrol at Gaeul's school and enter the Silent Reading Club, in which his brother was an active member, to uncover the circumstances that lead him to his tragic end. But is brotherly affection and filial piety the only reason Haneul is going this far? 

A story where every character, including the protagonist, hides a wealth of secrets that intertwine to create an impenetrable darkness which threatens to swallow them all...

Researcher Lou Solomon is given Caleb, his father's 'pet' during the zombie apocalypse. Will he be able to deal with the threats outside and within?

(Sorce: Toomics)

Ian joins the psychic organization N.E.R.D by chance. Will he be able to survive amongst the dangerous women of N.E.R.D? 

(Source: Toomics)

When Zak and the guardians left... The helpless people of Aria City were attacked. As the people despaired...There was a single gunshot: Zak was back.

description:
Women exist to be conquered. And the strongest man will conquer the most women. This is how one man thinks of the world, and he has lived by this creed for years. Will his appetite be his undoing...?

titles.title: Dad Is on His Way to Work

I never noticed this place existed... But I desperately needed to be comforted. Just what is this Daddy's Room?

In a futuristic, reunified Korea, a lone special forces agent is assigned to protect the idol group ORDO.

A young girl becomes the princess in a foreign kingdom and vies for the cold prince's love despite the obstacles that stand between them.

Instead, he becomes a 195 centimeter, heavily muscled, masculine man. Timid Woojong thus decides to create beauty instead, and changes his plans accordingly. This is how he meets "Ryuhyun", who studies modeling in the same university.

It's love at first sight for Woojong, who then asks Ryuhyun to become his model. Ryuhyun, who has secrets that stop him from loving himself, accepts Woojong's offer with a condition attached.

A story of how brawny yet adorable Woojong meets the gloomy yet beautiful Ryuhyun and helps him get over his past.

(Source: Copin Comics)

After being caught in an explosion caused by a meteor collision, Red wakes up to find that everything has changed. 

(Source: Toomics)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

A man and a woman with the same trauma, yet different personalities. Before them arrives the best mistake of their lives! 

“Ahreum” spends another depressing day working at the convenience store without a single call from her boyfriend. The arrival of a handsome but flamboyant customer “Kyungjun” makes her day become worse, with his date throwing up on the floor and Kyungjun’s continuous flirting. After the hectic day is over, she next meets Kyungjun at a totally unexpected place. Will meeting Kyungjun change her already complex life for the better or worse? 

(Source: Pocket Comics)

titles.title: ヒューイソフトクレンジング

description:
In a quiet neighborhood, there's a small store where people too tired to remove their own makeup come to visit. Run by the cool and chic CEO "Huey" and her cheerful part-timer "Sooyeon", the makeup removal specialty shop named "Huey Soft Cleansing" soothes both the heart and skin of the customers who visit the shop. A romantic aesthetic romance for the clean and mature minded women!!

Will has the ability to see and draw out the soul and energy of human bodies. He decides to use them to further his own sick and twisted purpose. 

(Source: Toomics)

romanized_title: Akai ito to Kamisama to Watashi

titles.title: Akai ito to Kamisama to Watashi

description:
She was the CEO of the wedding shop Honey Bouche. When she broke up with her ex right before their wedding, three men appear in front of her!

The three men start working for her when they turn out to be gods? What was her relationship with them in her past life, and who will stay with her in the present?

(Source: Copin Comics)

titles.title: ณ จุดเยือกแข็ง

description:
Saet-Byeol, a sharp-tongued Omega hiding his secondary gender, has no intention of ever finding a mate. But everything changes when he discovers that his classmate Yul, an emotional Alpha with a fate complex, is his destined pair. The catch? Yul believes Saet-Byeol is a Beta and mistakes his feelings for simple friendship. Determined to ignore his growing attraction, Saet-Byeol keeps his distance. When Jae-Young, an openly dominant Omega, transfers into their class and immediately captures Yul’s attention, Saet-Byeol finds it harder and harder to keep his own heart frozen.

A cold-blooded secret, a one-sided fate, and a love triangle that defies logic. How long can they keep their true desires buried before everything starts to melt?

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: ราตรีสวัสดิ์

I used to only obsess about money... But that changed when I met my childhood friend again... In the worst way possible...

(Source: Toomics)

There are many laws that protect women from men... But what about when a man is wrongly accused for rape? Attorney Jerk Goff to the rescue!

(Source: Toomics)

Dai gets brutally bullied at school. One day, his mother gets killed. Although he may be weak, Dai seeks for revenge. 

(Source: Toomics)

There's only one way to stop the hyenas from going for the big piece of meat. I have to become the king to protect my owner.

(Source: Toomics)

*Note:
Chapter count includes a prologue.*

Without a stable job or home, Joo May lives recklessly, drifting from one lover's house to another. One day, May passes out, almost beaten to death by an ex-boyfriend he bumped into. When he wakes, he finds himself chained up in the house of Shin Jooin, the clean-cut man who apparently rescued him. But there's something off about Jooin, who treats May almost like a pet\* Who is Jooin really, and what is he hiding?

(Source: TappyToon)

A man gets a job being a caretaker for a rich woman and her two beautiful daughters. The madam of the house gives him just one chance, as long as he never interacts with her daughters. Well they won't make it easy for him to do that...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

The spread of a virus of the national disaster proportion has shut down Seoul! Haebin, who lost all of his classmates in the incident a year ago, left home in order to avoid being alone again. What is the unexpected truth awaiting him that keeps him from regaining his normal daily life?!

Ashley was hanging between life and death when she was unexpectedly visited by an angel... What will happen to her now that she is living with an angel?! 

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: The President Is My Neighbor Cousin
mangabaka_title: The President Is My Neighbor Cousin

titles.title: The President Is My Neighbor Cousin

description: A third-rate manhwa author and the President of a large corporation head into a rather unsightly cohabitation work environment that's filled with fighting spirit!

The nationally-known superstar Oguri Ryu and his pet wolf Luna were best friends in public and in private. Ten years after they first met, as they watched the full moon at night, something suddenly happened to Luna. Startled, Oguri opened his eyes to find a naked girl in Luna's place! Ryu kept Luna by his side as a stylist to hide her true identity, but his uncle, who treated Ryu as a money-making tool, became suspicious of Ryu's relationship with the girl...? 

"I'll protect Ryu with my life!" 

A unique romance between the loyal wolf girl Luna, and her kind master! 

(Source: Piccoma, translated)

titles.title: ช่วยบอกว่ารักฉัน

description:
My first love from 11 years ago has returned, but this time... I'll make sure she tells me how she feels!

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: 諦める恋愛～叶わない恋～

description:
An impossible crush, a wish to make a difference.

Henry Kim, a 28-year-old private academy teacher, realizes that he has returned to the day he was taking the csat exam. Everything started with a phone call to his best friend Chance, who he had a crush on for ten years.

When Henry received an invitation to chance's wedding, he gets drunk out of a depression that he'd lose his best and his crush and speaks his true heart on the phone. "I wish you never met Lucy..." 

As if his wish had been answered, Henry travels back in time to the point where Chance and Lucy had not met yet. Now, it's up to Henry to correct his hasty wish and put an end to his long and painful crush.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Ms. Stockings used to play dating games for fun but now, she has to play to save the world? What kind of game is this? 

(Source: Toomics)

After his father’s death, Raymond seeks to find out more about his father’s work with werewolves, much of which was completed in secrecy. So he enters the Central Laboratory and meets Kata, the werewolf his father discovered years ago. He is one of three werewolves in the entire world to have been discovered by science. But Kata is a special specimen... in order for the laboratory to get the most out of their research, all of Kata’s needs must be met – including his voracious sexual appetite. Life at the lab has a long history of mixing work with pleasure, and it isn’t long until the lives of everyone at the Central Laboratory becomes tangled up with one another. 

(Source: Lezhin)

A star that loved a stalker, and a brother who lost his sibling.

On the day that star actor Yuri - who suddenly disappeared from the entertainment industry three years ago - makes a comeback, a flower basket is delivered to him along with a mysterious letter. After reading the letter, Yuri is stabbed by a stranger while trying to catch the sender. The culprit is Yuri's stalker, who had been pretending to be a delivery man. Just who is this mysterious stalker? Why does Yuri tirelessly chase him?

Meanwhile, Yuri's new manager Hyun continues to seep in to Yuri's life... Why does this man seem so familiar to Yuri?

A distorted love story between broken people, occurring within the flashy entertainment industry.

(Source: Copin Comics)

Countless girls come into this industry for money. Just think about it, do you think you can actually find love here? 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

The two main characters of our story may not know each other, but their lives take remarkably similar trajectories. Both work in the adult industry, yet both suffer performance issues. Namgeun works at an adult toy company, and his less than stellar performance in the bed leads his girlfriend to dump him. Meanwhile, Yeorang’s made a career as a sex columnist, but a leaked video reveals her inability to orgasm. Separately, they visit the local hardware store for rope to take their lives. But not only do they not die...it seems the rope has magically cured their sex issues. Now it’s time for Namgeum and Yeorang to discover the extent of the rope’s power. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Serena and Mitch are both outcasts who fall for each other. Trapped in a dangerous situation, will they both be able to escape and find paradise?

(Source: Toomics)

A fateful encounter between a girl and a... cat?

Moments after trying to save a cat from an oncoming truck, Ha-Ji Kang finds herself transported to Cat Kingdom. There, she encounters Gyeol-Han Ko, a cold and unforgiving prince, and is immediately thrown into a cell. What is this strange land, and will Haji be able to return home?

(Source: Manta) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

One of Sanghoon's preschool students ruins his friend’s coat. He frantically goes to his tailor to get the coat fixed, only to find it closed. Running out of time, Sanghoon looks for another tailor, who happens to be Deokjin… 

(Source: Lalatoon)

titles.title: Sở Thích Thầm Kín Của Quý Ông
รสนิยมลับของสุภาพบุรุษ

description:
A fun and sexy love story from the office! CEO Jungwon Han has it all--exceptional looks, high intellect, and great business sense. But all the advances from beautiful women don't move him in the slightest for he has a secret. What is his secret that he prefers a Renoir painting over a girlfriend?

(Source: Copin Comics)

Jan finds himself strangely attracted to the hugo Jamil. Is it true love Jan seeks, or a sense of stability? 

(Source: Toomics)

They say there's a dark side to the entertainment industry. But it's all a rumor, right?

(Source: Toomics) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

titles.title: 男女４人 一つ屋根の下で…

description:
A boy was raised by his "Aunt" into a fine young man. He thought they would have the same relationship forever. But one day he sees something he shouldn't have, and their lives will never be the same again.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

titles.title: Egoism ฝืนชะตารัก

description:
After his father remarries, Jaeun must now live under the same roof with his new stepbrother Jihan. However, life isn't easy when their abusive Alpha father is hellbent on controlling their lives. Things only get worse when Jaeun is revealed to be an Omega. Abandoned by his family and friends, Jaeun realizes he only has Jihan to depend on. Now as adults and living together, will this bond withstand the heat of an Omega? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: Risky Scandal, Such a Young Mom
mangabaka_title: Risky Scandal, Such a Young Mom

titles.title: Risky Scandal, Such a Young Mom

description:
Soo-han, who happened to be boarding at a close friend's house. But... even if my friend's mom is pretty, she's so pretty?!

(Source: Lezhin X)

Taeyoung and Ami, young lovers from a peaceful lakeside town, grew up sharing dreams of fame and freedom. Taeyoung, son of actress Im Haedo, yearns to capture beauty from behind the camera, while Ami aspires to dazzle in front of it. But when Haedo’s film director boyfriend comes to town hunting for his next leading lady, the couple’s tranquility is shattered forever… 

(Source: Lezhin US)

A marriage of convenience shouldn’t stop you from having fun! Playboy lawyer Taeshik’s determined to make his last day as a single man as memorable as possible. A club is the best place for sexy encounters that don’t last, and Taeshik thinks that his one-night stand with Heejoo will be nothing more than a one-night stand…until the next day when he finds out that she’s actually his bride-to-be! This could be an opportunity for him, so he decides to train her to be the one and only bride for him. “I promise I’ll make you happy, so…can you do me a favor?”

(Source: Lezhin X)

Rain awakens him in me. "don't be ashamed..." He knows all my desires, and I desire him more than anything in this world.

(Source: Toomics)

Min-Jae loved a girl in high school but could never tell her how he really felt. Now years have passed and he has moved on and married someone else. But when he goes to his high school reunion he is reunited with her and it sparks an old flame.

Man-Suk has lived a timid life as a cripple. However, he is able to walk again after a miraculous event. He sets out to find his first love with his new legs, but little did he know, there were more changes than just his legs. 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

titles.title: Liang Ge Baba Yi Ge Wa

description:
A two-dad parenting team!
Doting father Sung-Sil suddenly discovers his wife is a gangster and their son isn't actually his! The real father, actor Seung-Heon Kang, reclaims his child but soon realizes he can't handle the constant wailing. Can these two men find a way to work together and raise little Hyun-Woo? 

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: The World That Only We Know of
私たちだけが知る世界

description:
When Ara is invited to have a threesome by the alluring Yoojin, she doesn’t expect her old high school friend Seungmin to show up as their third member. They’ve shared many things with each other back in the day, including discussions about sex, but they’ve never shared their bodies before. Tonight, though, everything is going to change. The question is: will it just be their bodies they share, or will there be something more?

(Source: Lezhin X)

I never really thought she was pretty. I just thought she had a nice smile. So... how did I fall in love with my girlfriend's best friend? 

(Source: Toomics)

description:
A mystery tale of young women gripped by the ghost of an encounter with a skeleton. "Eunha Chae" witnessed the shocking death of her friend a few years ago. 

After the "skeleton incident", she herself turned into a psychological menace to her classmates because of her nightmares. 

One day, "Soyeong Han", a girl claiming to have experienced something similar four years ago returns to school. And now she's asking Eunha for her help in finding out the truth. 

(Source: Pocket Comics)

titles.title: El trabajo a tiempo parcial de Yuri

Yu-Ri is the perfect college student, so no one suspects she’s living a double life at night. Until Professor Baek finds out about her secret part-time job...

“You want your phone back? Be my girlfriend!”
“Why!”
“Because I want it!”
“Then for how long?”
“Till the day before my birthday~”
But which birthday? Nobody knows.

Just when I was ready to give up on life, a mysterious woman comes to save me… Only to put a new snare around my neck.

Former best-seller author Kaiden meets his old crush Sonya in a bicycle crash. Where will fate lead them next?

On her way back home late one night, office worker Sophie stumbles into another world where she's a princess?! Well that's what Alan, prince of the Lapis Kingdom, says. To return to her world she must fulfill the prophecy and help Alan become king. Sophie agrees but...amidst a war for the crown, can she survive?

An ordinary housewife's life turns to hell after falling into the hands of a vicious loan shark. 

(Source: Toptoon)

Sweet, adorable Narae. The girl next door that everyone loves! Except, she has just one little secret- she fantasizes about having sex with anyone and everyone! Men, women, BDSM, toys, you name it, it’s in there. Nothing is off limits for Narae. Now these fantasies are starting to get out of control and affect her dating (and social) life. With help from the mysterious shamaness Nokjoo and the influential Miss Miso, Narae will find a way to make these fantasies a reality and finally get herself a boyfriend.

What kind of loser can't get into a single college? Well, one guy knows the feeling. But hey, chin up dude. Your older brother is letting you manage a share house full of college girls. Maybe things aren't as bad as they seem?

Ga-Ram lost her best friend in an accident back in high school. Years have passed, but she still suffers from deep depression and insomnia. She finally decides to face her greatest pain...

From her looks to her background, everything about Mia seems so ordinary. But then she lands a job as the secretary of Siwoo Lee, a former model who is now a director at Taeyang Group, a conglomerate he is set to inherit. Siwoo is a notorious playboy and Mia finds out that she only got the job because she was the farthest thing from his type. But as they work together, she proves to be very capable and always seems to be there when he needs her the most. A love story blooms during a critical situation in which you have to do anything in order to survive!
