As Sharon, a wealthy and beautiful noblewoman, she has everything she could possibly want, but she's destined to die a pitiful death at the age of 20 after being betrayed by her best friend, Carol — the villainess! 

Rather than waiting for death, she takes it upon herself to raise Carol — whose terrible personality resulted from bad parenting — into a better person, and save both of their lives to change their future!

A group of high school friends have a tradition that they continue to honour even as adults: an annual Christmas gift exchange. Nam Yoontae is handsome, popular, easy-going, and the womaniser of the group. Nerdy, bespectacled Seong Chan, who only ended up with a gang of boys his polar opposite because they needed his help getting through exams, has been harbouring a secret crush for the other man since their schooldays. 

Seong Chan dutifully attends the gift exchange every year for one reason, and one reason only: to have Yoontae receive his gift. But this Christmas, it seems that something even more shocking it about to happen.

They settled the misunderstandings, but Gyojin is now bothered because Hyeono started courting him. While trying his best to reject Hyeono, Gyojin’s senior from college, the source of his trauma of Alphas, re-appeared in his life. And this sunbae also turned out to be one of his superiors…

As a replacement, his landlord sent him a humanoid air conditioner that is all the rage overseas, taking form in a handsome male model. As soon as it is turned on, it became so cool that he cuddled it, but he can’t help feeling a bit weird. As he was cuddling this temporary replacement of his AC, he pressed a button located “somewhere” and it opened it’s eyes. Turns out that not only did his humanoid have a handsome face, he also has a kind personality and a gentle voice… This totally perfect AC’s over friendliness gradually included skinship, as well as relieving his sex drive that has been long stifled by the heat…

However, upon waking up the next morning he is no longer in bed with a cute baby kitten, but a grown, handsome man?! “I am this person’s owner!” he says! Stay tuned to watch how Seung-Woo and Mr. Cat’s relationship develops…!

For eighteen years, I lived under various abuses as a s\*ave for my family. Fortunately, before my parents forced me to be sold to the villain like in the original novel, I succeeded in running away. I spent a short but happy time with Momo, a stray dog I met in a rural village. But three months later, the pampered puppy disappeared! To make matters worse, I was captured by my family and was given to the villain. 

The moment I was discouraged when I was about to die, 

*“Why are you so surprised? It’s me, Momo, your puppy.”*

My beloved pet turned into a villain? And that villain is my “fated counterpart”?

There is another girl, who started swimming because her life wasn't fun, but then ended up showing genuine promise, even though swimming was just a joke to her. Like this, the two of them met each other, forming the worst relationship, akin to water and oil, the modern version of Mozart and Salieri, leading to the romance of dreams and youth.

Eden is a member of the Timekeeper family, who possess the ability to travel back in time. Their date of death has been set since the day they were born... and the summer of 2018 is when Eden is destined to die. On that fateful day, he decides to confess his feelings to his longtime crush. But Jay, who is straight and only cherishes Eden as a friend, is flustered by Eden’s confession and reacts badly. Caught up in his thoughts, Eden is met with a fatal accident—and thus his time travel begins. He finds himself on the last day of the high school summer camp training where he first met Jay. Given the opportunity, will Eden be able to change anything that happened on that day, 20 years ago?

The story of Hui-Ye, who is currently attending a middle school for girls, and Seo-Yun, her senior at school and someone that caught Hui-Ye's eye instantly.

Depicts the dark sides of love and society during the fresh adolescence period from the perspective of two high school students Park Chan-Hong and Heo Don-Hyuk.

I passed out after a day filled with misfortune. When I later opened my eyes, I was inside my favorite novel. Unfortunately, I was reincarnated as the villainess who was ruined after wreaking havoc due to her obsession with the male lead… That doesn’t matter! I won’t become a villainess, and will instead match my favorite character in this novel, the second male lead, with the heroine! But this is… harder than I imagined?!?! 

*“Are you alright?”*

The captain of the knights who was supposed to be the heroine’s bodyguard ended up as my own. 

*“I got it for free on the way here. Eat it.”*

The guy who is supposed to help the two end up together keeps going off track by 3000%. 

*“Are you out of your mind? I told you to be careful!”*

And the male lead who is supposed to hate me is annoyingly hovering around. 

*”I’ll feed you, Lia!”*

Even the heroine had no interest in anyone, not even the original male lead?! Not only that! 

*“Thank you. I’ll treasure it.”*

My heart started beating for Ain who suddenly appeared without warning! Will Lia be able to save the second male lead’s love?

A few generations ago, a mysterious phenomenon occurred. Humans now die after 1.5 billion heartbeats; half the heart rate they originally had. Schools began teaching students how to control their emotions and regularly performed heart rate tests. No one is allowed to use more than the number assigned per week.

Ariel was born in the Marquis family, where she was abused and abandoned. She ended up with a miserable death after a life of endless misfortune. Then she woke up, and she was nine years old again. In order to not repeat her miserable life, Ariel decides to have a contractual marriage with the son of the grand duke, Lakarter, who is famous for blood and madness. 

*"What are all these keys for?"*

The housekeeper glanced at the keys and laughed.

*"These keys are for the treasury of the grand duke’s family."*

She can use all of them as she pleases because they are all hers.

However, the chef at the restaurant who arrived in the heat of the day said, “You can’t starve,” and she was introduced by a friend. Why do you feel like you’re in a relationship now? Can I start a new relationship?

"I thought we were friends." "Your Highness is from the royal family of Joseon, and I am only a soldier of the Japanese Empire." The precarious relationship between the two men, who loved their countries more than anyone else!  
The two men who perished along with the two empires at their twilight; the unfortunate Lee Woo, who was born as a descendant of the Korean Empire's imperial family and yet had to live his entire life wearing the Japanese military uniform until his tragic death in the atomic bombing of Hiroshima, and Yoshinari Hiromu, his Lieutenant and one of the last soldiers of the Japanese Empire.

***Important Note:**  
This story is based on real historical figures, Prince Lee Woo and Yoshinari Hiroshi> Under the oppressive rule of Imperial Japan following Korea's annexation into the Empire of Japan, the Joseon Empire had practically collapsed. At a very young age, Lee Woo was forcefully taken to Japan as a political hostage under the pretense of educational purposes. Rebellious and defiant in the beginning, while harboring a fervent desire to go back home one day to a free country & be reunited with his loved ones, he maintained his integrity as a Korean, despite his Japanese education. But after many years of being used as a political pawn, all the while helplessly witnessing the suffering of his own people, he was left a broken man by the time the war reached its height. Then, entered Yoshinari Hiromu, a Japanese soldier from low social class & a former classmate, who was assigned as his Lieutenant to monitor his activities by the Japanese Imperial General Headquarters. Despite their differences, the two forged an unlikely friendship as they navigated the treacherous political divide between their two countries amidst the intensifying war.*

An ordinary high school student Jaein becomes a ‘Holder’ who kills and gains time.

Misery and misfortune have come knocking into 19 year old Jaein’s life. The death of his father is followed by the sudden and the death of his mother from a rare disease. And to make matters worse Jaein himself is terminally ill. The one relative that he has left is trying to blackmail Jaein of the insurance money by using his little sister, who is blind.

The situation overwhelms Jaein. While asleep he dreams of a pair of crimson eyes looking down upon him. A shadowy monster like figure that calls himself ‘D’ offers to extend his life by 7 days for every one person Jaein kills. When Jaein’s life is extended for 7 days, he gains the ability to read people’s intentions. After Jaein indirectly causes the death of his grandfather he meets detective Taeoh. The detective knows Jaein’s secret and tells him about the ‘holder’ people who like Jaein imprison monsters inside them. Taeoh convinces Jaein to use his gift for others by solving cold cases. This all changes when he meets the profiler John that works in the department. Only Jaein can stop John’s diabolical plan.

**"We are just living our own lives. There's no fixed answer to life."
Stories of people "having the time of your life".

A piece of cake of comfort to you, who survived a tiring and hard day today.**

Ji-Yeong, who quit her job and pursues her dream, Eun-Hye, who decided to break up after a long relationship, and Hye-Su, a working mother who is tired of work and childcare... This work, which depicts the clumsy lives of characters in their 30s, resembles us who are standing on the path of growth. As the author said, "When I was in my 20s, I thought my 30s would be a more wonderful and special life, but now that I'm 33, I'm still struggling and full of mistakes," We, who grow up and seek small pleasures, can sympathize and find comfort in this work.

(Source: Jaemijuui, translated)
